title: THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE
text:
NEW WIRED PICTURE SERVICE FOR THE JOURNAL INTRODUCES PORTABLE SENDING MACHINE

Within fifteen minutes after his connection was established with this office, the completed duplicate of the Savoy picture was in The Journal dark room ready for printing.

This view was made in the photograph studio of Geo. W. Wear at Sherman while the picture on page 201 was being transmitted by telephone wire from Sherman to Dallas.

CORRESPONDENCE WITH EX-STUDENTS.—In addition to newspaper publicity, the advance planning included the sending out of a questionnaire to ex-students, to be filled out and returned to the secretary by every ex-student of the Savoy College who could be found; a printed booklet of the tentative two-day reunion program; and a final card of invitation on July 20, 1938, urging all ex-students and friends of the College to attend the reunion in Savoy, August 6 and 7, 1938. The response to the mailing of the questionnaire and application for banquet reservations (the only mailing asking a written answer) was encouraging to the committee as 124 forms were returned.
notes: Printed page number 200 appears at top left. Title 'THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE' appears at top. Photograph visible at bottom of page but no caption text readable.
